review.rationale: Primary review of all 25 people on the Colorado School of Mines directory filtered to Electrical Engineering and the department emeriti page, reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit. 12 regular faculty are included, including department head Abd Arkadan on a project-owner determination dated 2026-11-25 (no Mines page states his rank in words; an academic-catalog page lists him as Interim Department Head and Teaching Professor, which would exclude him if current). Teaching professors, an adjunct and seven emeriti are excluded.
review.independent_review_scope: Full-roster independent audit of 25 directory entries.
